feasibility.basis_zh: 上游提供浏览器安装器和命令行安装器，支持矩阵列出已测试 Kobo 型号；但固件 5.x 尚不支持，仍须先核对型号与固件。
feasibility.basis_en: Upstream provides browser and command-line installers plus a tested-device matrix, but Kobo firmware 5.x is not supported and the exact model/firmware must still be checked.

docs_community.basis_zh: README、安装/恢复/卸载文档、设备矩阵、发布包和 2026 年持续提交均可直接核验。
docs_community.basis_en: The README, install/recovery/uninstall guide, device matrix, releases, and continuing 2026 commits are directly verifiable.

practical_value.basis_zh: 同一平台提供启动器、应用商店、签名应用更新与多种离线/联网应用，同时保留 Kobo 原阅读器。
practical_value.basis_en: One platform provides a launcher, app store, signed app updates, and many offline/online apps while retaining Kobo's stock reader.

risk.basis_zh: 上游记录签名清单校验、安装中断保留工作版本，并提供恢复与卸载流程；仍属于对阅读器的软件修改。
risk.basis_en: Upstream documents signed-manifest verification, preserving the working version after interrupted installs, plus recovery and uninstall procedures; it still modifies reader software.

feasibility.basis_zh: GUI 会自动识别 reMarkable 1/2/Paper Pro 架构并执行安装，但仍要求 Python 3.10、SSH、USB/Wi-Fi 和联网下载。
feasibility.basis_en: The GUI auto-detects reMarkable 1/2/Paper Pro architectures and drives installation, but Python 3.10, SSH, USB/Wi-Fi, and internet access remain prerequisites.

docs_community.basis_zh: README 有设备矩阵、依赖、完整操作与故障恢复说明，并提供版本化发布包；仓库在 2026 年仍有更新。
docs_community.basis_en: The README provides a device matrix, requirements, full workflow, and recovery guidance with versioned releases; the repository was still updated in 2026.

practical_value.basis_zh: 可安装 XOVI、AppLoad 与 KOReader，并覆盖三代 reMarkable，能把封闭设备转为可运行第三方应用的终端。
practical_value.basis_en: It installs XOVI, AppLoad, and KOReader across three reMarkable generations, enabling third-party applications on otherwise closed devices.

risk.basis_zh: 上游明确在修改前自动备份，提供备份恢复、完整卸载与错误回退；仍要求设备在安装期间保持充足电量。
risk.basis_en: Upstream documents automatic pre-change backups, restore management, full uninstall, and recovery fallbacks, while requiring adequate charge during installation.

feasibility.basis_zh: Kobo 固件至少 2.9.0 即可，安装为把完整 ZIP 解压到 USB 根目录；兼容范围广，但固件升级后需要重装。
feasibility.basis_en: Kobo firmware 2.9.0 or newer is required and installation is an intact ZIP extraction to the USB root; device coverage is broad, but firmware updates require reinstalling it.

docs_community.basis_zh: README 详细覆盖安装、配置、日志、限制、升级与卸载，并链接发布包和持续维护的讨论；2026 年仍有提交。
docs_community.basis_en: The README thoroughly covers install, configuration, logs, limitations, upgrades, and uninstall, links maintained release discussions, and the repository still had 2026 commits.

practical_value.basis_zh: 以文件事件启动 KOReader、Plato 或自定义动作，是旧 Kobo 运行第三方软件的通用入口。
practical_value.basis_en: It launches KOReader, Plato, or custom actions through file events, providing a general third-party software entry point on older Kobos.

risk.basis_zh: 上游提供自动卸载包和恢复启动脚本说明；它会修改启动脚本，但固件升级会恢复原脚本。
risk.basis_en: Upstream provides an automated uninstaller and startup-script restoration guidance; it patches a startup script, but firmware updates restore the vendor script.

feasibility.basis_zh: 有预编译发布包和四步安装，但要求 Kindle SSH、外部图片服务器，并只在 Kindle 4 NT 实测。
feasibility.basis_en: Prebuilt releases and a four-step install exist, but Kindle SSH and an external image server are required, and only Kindle 4 NT is tested.

docs_community.basis_zh: README 和技巧文档清楚、发布包可下载，但仓库最后一次可见更新为 2024 年，当前社区活跃度有限。
docs_community.basis_en: The README and tips documentation are clear and releases remain downloadable, but the last visible repository update was in 2024, limiting current activity.

practical_value.basis_zh: 定期下载任意服务器生成的图片，更新后挂起到 RAM，可把旧 Kindle 变为低功耗通用信息板。
practical_value.basis_en: It periodically fetches arbitrary server-rendered images and suspends to RAM after refresh, turning an old Kindle into a general low-power dashboard.

feasibility.basis_zh: 虽有一体化 KoboRoot 包，但需要改内核获得 USB OTG、外接供电键盘，且仅在 Kobo Glo HD 与法语 AZERTY 键盘实测。
feasibility.basis_en: A bundled KoboRoot package exists, but a modified USB-OTG kernel and externally powered keyboard are required, with testing limited to Kobo Glo HD and a French AZERTY keyboard.

docs_community.basis_zh: README 记录架构、依赖、预编译安装和限制，但构建步骤仍标为 TODO，最后可见更新在 2024 年。
docs_community.basis_en: The README records architecture, dependencies, prebuilt installation, and limitations, but detailed build steps remain TODO and the last visible update was in 2024.

practical_value.basis_zh: 可把特定旧 Kobo 变成可编辑文本文件的低干扰打字机，并可切回原厂阅读软件，但设备和键盘覆盖很窄。
practical_value.basis_en: It can turn a specific old Kobo into a distraction-free text-file typewriter and switch back to stock reading software, but device and keyboard coverage is narrow.

risk.basis_zh: 安装说明明确写明风险自负，并安装带修改内核的 XCSoar 环境；USB OTG 状态还会阻止原厂软件启动，需重启切换。
risk.basis_en: The install guide explicitly says use is at one's own risk and installs an XCSoar environment with a modified kernel; USB-OTG mode also blocks stock software until a rebooted mode change.

feasibility.basis_zh: 越狱后可直接用搜索栏命令安装、更新和卸载软件；但它以完成越狱为前置条件，平台包也有明确机型标识。
feasibility.basis_en: After jailbreaking, search-bar commands install, update, and remove software, but a completed jailbreak is prerequisite and packages carry explicit platform constraints.

docs_community.basis_zh: 有官方 Homebrew 指南、包格式 README、示例包和在线仓库，且 2026 年仍活跃；核心 README 本身较精简。
docs_community.basis_en: There is an official homebrew guide, package-format README, example package, and live repository with 2026 activity, although the core README itself is terse.

practical_value.basis_zh: 能在 Kindle 上统一安装、更新、启动和卸载 KOReader、kTerm 等 Homebrew 软件，降低后续复用门槛。
practical_value.basis_en: It centralizes installing, updating, launching, and removing Kindle homebrew such as KOReader and kTerm, reducing follow-on reuse friction.

risk.basis_zh: 官方指南明确警告未知来源 Scriptlet 可植入恶意软件或刷坏设备；包钩子以 shell 执行，必须信任仓库和安装脚本。
risk.basis_en: The official guide warns that untrusted scriptlets can install malware or brick a device, and package hooks execute via shell, so repository and install-script trust is critical.

feasibility.basis_zh: 安装只需把预编译 KoboRoot.tgz 复制进 `.kobo` 后弹出设备；但当前明确不支持 Kobo 固件 5.x。
feasibility.basis_en: Installation is a copy of the prebuilt KoboRoot.tgz into `.kobo` followed by ejecting the device, but Kobo firmware 5.x is explicitly unsupported.

docs_community.basis_zh: README、内置文档、发布包和 MobileRead 支持入口齐全，仓库在 2026 年仍有提交。
docs_community.basis_en: The README, bundled documentation, releases, and MobileRead support entry points are available, with repository commits continuing in 2026.

practical_value.basis_zh: 直接在 Kobo 菜单中启动脚本、切换隐藏设置和执行动作，是多种第三方应用的实用入口。
practical_value.basis_en: It exposes scripts, hidden settings, and actions directly in Kobo menus, serving as a practical entry point for many third-party applications.

risk.basis_zh: 上游提供创建卸载标记文件的一步卸载法，以及开机后立即关机触发的 failsafe。
risk.basis_en: Upstream provides a one-file uninstall trigger and a boot-time power-off failsafe mechanism.

feasibility.basis_zh: 项目处于早期，只在少数 Kobo 测试；安装需要在 ARM 环境构建 rootfs、备份内部存储、拆机并改写 microSD/启动内容。
feasibility.basis_en: The project is early-stage and tested on few Kobos; installation requires an ARM build environment, a full internal-storage backup, device disassembly, and microSD/boot-content changes.

docs_community.basis_zh: README 对硬件矩阵、构建、分区与备份写得详细，但项目自称早期阶段，仓库最后可见更新停在 2020 年。
docs_community.basis_en: The README is detailed about hardware matrices, builds, partitions, and backups, but calls the project early-stage and the last visible repository update was in 2020.

practical_value.basis_zh: 目标是以 Debian 与 KOReader 提供无 DRM、无追踪的完整自由软件栈，但当前仅少数老型号可用且关键 GUI 功能缺失。
practical_value.basis_en: It aims to provide a DRM-free, spyware-free Debian/KOReader stack, but only a few older models are supported and key GUI functions are missing.

risk.basis_zh: 上游两次明确警告可能刷坏设备，并要求至少备份前 15 MiB、最好完整备份；还记录并发写数据分区可能损坏数据。
risk.basis_en: Upstream twice warns that installation may brick the reader, requires at least the first 15 MiB and preferably the full storage to be backed up, and notes concurrent writes may corrupt data.

feasibility.basis_zh: 上游列出精确固件门槛和 19 个支持型号，并提供一键安装包；升级时需阅读发布说明，个别版本可能要人工处理。
feasibility.basis_en: Upstream lists an exact firmware threshold and 19 supported models and provides one-click packages; upgrades may still require manual actions described in release notes.

docs_community.basis_zh: README、指南、用户手册、构建文档和发布说明齐全，仓库在 2026 年仍有提交。
docs_community.basis_en: The README, guide, user manual, build documentation, and release notes are available, and repository commits continued in 2026.

practical_value.basis_zh: 覆盖 PDF、EPUB、CBZ、FB2、MOBI、DJVU 等格式，并提供批注、书签、字典、裁边和连续缩放等核心阅读能力。
practical_value.basis_en: It covers PDF, EPUB, CBZ, FB2, MOBI, DJVU, and more, with core reading features such as annotations, bookmarks, dictionaries, cropping, and continuous zoom.

feasibility.basis_zh: 上游明确称旧 Quill 需要专家级 Linux/编译能力和大量时间；原生系统还需取出或访问 SD 卡并写入镜像。
feasibility.basis_en: Upstream explicitly says the old Quill needs expert Linux/compilation skills and substantial time; native OS installation also requires imaging the device SD card.

docs_community.basis_zh: README 仍保留安装、功能与社区入口，仓库 2026 年有提交，但上游明确表示不保证支持且暂无正式更新计划。
docs_community.basis_en: The README retains install, feature, and community links and the repo had 2026 commits, but upstream explicitly says to expect no support and no official updates for now.

practical_value.basis_zh: 作为完整开源系统可阅读 EPUB/PDF/图片/文本并提供 Wi-Fi、浏览器和 X11，但现实适配和维护状态大幅限制用途。
practical_value.basis_en: As a full open-source OS it reads EPUB/PDF/images/text and offers Wi-Fi, a browser, and X11, but actual portability and maintenance status sharply limit utility.

risk.basis_zh: 上游明确不提供担保并警告工厂镜像或更新包可能刷坏设备；安装涉及直接向 SD 卡写系统镜像。
risk.basis_en: Upstream disclaims warranty and explicitly warns that factory images or update bundles may brick the device; installation writes an OS image directly to the SD card.

feasibility.basis_zh: 作为 PWA 只需在 Kindle、Kobo 或其他电子墨水设备浏览器打开网址，无需安装或越狱，并提供现代、Lite 与 Legacy 三个构建目标。
feasibility.basis_en: As a PWA it only needs its URL opened in a Kindle, Kobo, or other e-ink browser, with no install or jailbreak, and it ships modern, Lite, and Legacy build targets.

docs_community.basis_zh: README 详细列出安装、三类兼容构建、功能、隐私与自托管步骤，应用内还有可搜索帮助；仓库在 2026 年持续更新。
docs_community.basis_en: The README details setup, three compatibility builds, features, privacy, and self-hosting, while the app contains searchable help; the repository continued updating in 2026.

practical_value.basis_zh: 在不改固件的前提下提供 EPUB、RSS、日历、游戏、邮件和生产力工具，并为老 WebKit Kindle/Kobo 单独降级构建。
practical_value.basis_en: Without firmware changes it provides EPUB, RSS, calendar, games, mail, and productivity tools, with dedicated down-level builds for older WebKit Kindles and Kobos.

risk.basis_zh: 不修改设备固件；访客模式数据只保存在本地。云同步和 Google 集成会引入账户与令牌，但上游说明令牌留在设备端。
risk.basis_en: It does not modify firmware and Guest Mode keeps data locally. Cloud sync and Google integrations introduce accounts and tokens, but upstream states tokens stay on-device.

feasibility.basis_zh: 安装本身是一条 SSH 命令且基础占用约 13 MB，但要求 root SSH 与联网；系统更新后还要重新建立 `/opt` 挂载。
feasibility.basis_en: Installation is one SSH command and the base footprint is about 13 MB, but root SSH and internet access are required and `/opt` must be remounted after system updates.

docs_community.basis_zh: README 清楚覆盖安装、更新后恢复、空间问题和卸载，但材料规模较小，最后可见更新为 2024 年。
docs_community.basis_en: The README clearly covers install, post-update recovery, storage issues, and uninstall, but the material is small and the last visible update was in 2024.

practical_value.basis_zh: 给 reMarkable 增加 Entware/opkg 软件仓库，可直接安装 Git 等大量嵌入式 Linux 工具。
practical_value.basis_en: It adds the Entware/opkg repository to reMarkable, enabling installation of Git and many embedded-Linux utilities.

risk.basis_zh: 文档让 root shell 通过明文 HTTP URL 下载并直接执行脚本；虽有明确卸载步骤且数据主要留在 `/home/root`，供应链与 root 修改风险仍高。
risk.basis_en: The documented root shell downloads and executes a script through a plain-HTTP URL. Explicit uninstall exists and data mainly stays under `/home/root`, but supply-chain and root-modification risk remains high.

feasibility.basis_zh: 安装命令短，但属于 root 级二进制补丁，严格绑定 rM1/rM2 的旧固件版本，设备升级后补丁会丢失。
feasibility.basis_en: The command is short, but it applies root-level binary patches tied to specific old rM1/rM2 firmware versions and is removed by device updates.

docs_community.basis_zh: README 有精确版本矩阵、功能、安装、卸载和故障说明，但最后可见提交为 2023 年，只适用于历史固件线。
docs_community.basis_en: The README has an exact version matrix, features, install, uninstall, and troubleshooting, but the last visible commit was in 2023 and it only covers historical firmware lines.

practical_value.basis_zh: 在原厂界面上增加书签、页面操作、界面快捷功能等大量日常能力，不必换整套系统。
practical_value.basis_en: It adds many daily-use capabilities such as bookmarks, page operations, and UI shortcuts to the stock interface without replacing the whole OS.

risk.basis_zh: 上游明确说明违反厂商 EULA，可能有漏洞、丢数据或崩溃；它直接补丁原厂二进制，并提示部分操作前先备份。
risk.basis_en: Upstream states it violates the vendor EULA and may contain bugs, lose data, or crash; it directly patches vendor binaries and tells users to back up before some operations.

feasibility.basis_zh: 客户端只需复制应用，服务器有完整 Linux 构建/安装命令，并列出多款实测 PocketBook；但仅支持 Linux/Raspberry Pi 主机和 24 位色深。
feasibility.basis_en: The reader client is copied as an app and the Linux server has complete build/install commands with several tested PocketBooks, but hosts are limited to Linux/Raspberry Pi and 24-bit color depth.

docs_community.basis_zh: README 对兼容型号、安装、网络、快捷键和排障很详细，并链接用户实测报告；但仓库最后可见更新为 2021 年。
docs_community.basis_en: The README is detailed on compatible models, installation, networking, shortcuts, and troubleshooting and links user reports, but the last visible update was in 2021.

practical_value.basis_zh: 可把多款旧 PocketBook 通过 Wi-Fi/USB 变成 Linux 副屏，并提供窗口跟踪和输入辅助；刷新慢、屏幕小且平台受限。
practical_value.basis_en: It turns several older PocketBooks into Linux secondary displays over Wi-Fi/USB with window tracking and input aids, but refresh, screen size, and host platform limit use.

risk.basis_zh: 作者明确警告频繁刷新可能损坏并非为此刷新率设计的电子墨水屏，且不承担设备损坏责任。
risk.basis_en: The author explicitly warns that frequent updates may damage an e-ink display not designed for that refresh rate and disclaims responsibility for device damage.

feasibility.basis_zh: Kobo 路径为复制预构建 KoboRoot.tgz，reMarkable 路径可经 Toltec/opkg 安装；Kobo 仅明确支持 Clara HD、Libra H2O、Elipsa 2E。
feasibility.basis_en: The Kobo route is a prebuilt KoboRoot.tgz copy and reMarkable installs can use Toltec/opkg; Kobo support is explicitly limited to Clara HD, Libra H2O, and Elipsa 2E.

docs_community.basis_zh: README、独立文档站、逐应用说明、持续构建服务和构建文档齐全，仓库在 2025 年仍有更新。
docs_community.basis_en: The README, dedicated documentation site, per-app guides, continuous build service, and build documentation are available, with repository updates continuing in 2025.

practical_value.basis_zh: 提供绘图、应用切换、包管理、手势启动器和开发库，使 reMarkable/Kobo 可运行并开发多类原生应用。
practical_value.basis_en: It provides drawing, app switching, package management, gesture launching, and development libraries for running and building native apps on reMarkable/Kobo.

feasibility.basis_zh: SSH 引导命令简短且覆盖 rM1/rM2，但官方只支持 OS 2.6.1.71–3.3.2.1666；最新系统必须改用其他工具。
feasibility.basis_en: The SSH bootstrap is short and supports rM1/rM2, but official support is limited to OS 2.6.1.71–3.3.2.1666, with other tools recommended for current OS versions.

docs_community.basis_zh: 官网有安装、兼容表、FAQ、包索引、恢复和卸载说明；仓库已在 2026 年归档并明确推荐后继方案。
docs_community.basis_en: The site provides install, compatibility, FAQ, package index, recovery, and uninstall material; the repository was archived in 2026 and explicitly points to successors.

practical_value.basis_zh: 在受支持旧系统上统一管理 Toltec 与 Entware 软件，可安装、更新、删除应用并使用图形包管理器。
practical_value.basis_en: On supported older OS versions it manages Toltec and Entware software, enabling install, update, removal, and an optional graphical package manager.

risk.basis_zh: 官网明确警告在不支持系统安装会软变砖，并禁止带 Toltec 直接恢复出厂；必须先用 `toltecctl uninstall`。
risk.basis_en: The official site explicitly warns that unsupported OS versions can soft-brick and says not to factory-reset with Toltec installed; `toltecctl uninstall` must be run first.

feasibility.basis_zh: 装好 NickelMenu 后，只需下载发布包并解压到 Kobo 根目录；自行构建才需要 Qt6、工具链和平台插件。
feasibility.basis_en: After NickelMenu is installed, the release archive is simply extracted to the Kobo root; Qt6, toolchains, and platform plugins are only needed for source builds.

docs_community.basis_zh: README 清楚区分终端安装与交叉编译，发布包持续提供，仓库在 2026 年仍有更新。
docs_community.basis_en: The README clearly separates end-user install from cross-compilation, releases remain available, and repository updates continued in 2026.

practical_value.basis_zh: 为 Kobo 优化在线漫画、多来源检索、离线下载、收藏、进度、手势、前灯和睡眠模式，使用闭环完整。
practical_value.basis_en: It provides a complete Kobo-focused manga loop with multiple sources, search, offline downloads, favorites, progress, gestures, front-light control, and sleep mode.

feasibility.basis_zh: 需要识别 39 针面板、制作/焊接转接板、产生多路正负高压并处理严格时序；仅特定备用屏得到输出，不是即插即用方案。
feasibility.basis_en: It requires identifying a 39-pin panel, fabricating/soldering an adapter, generating multiple positive/negative rails, and handling tight timing; output was demonstrated only on a specific spare panel.

docs_community.basis_zh: 项目公开 11 篇日志、原理图、元件表、Gerber/PCB 和驱动源码，也诚实记录失败；但最后更新在 2019 年。
docs_community.basis_en: The project exposes 11 logs, a schematic, BOM, Gerber/PCB files, driver source, and failure evidence, but was last updated in 2019.

practical_value.basis_zh: 在特定拆机屏上已显示黑白并后来取得灰阶，能减少电子纸逆向工作；仍无通用面板适配、成品或长期稳定结果。
practical_value.basis_en: Black-and-white output and later grayscale were achieved on a specific salvaged panel, reducing reverse-engineering work, but there is no universal panel support, finished product, or long-term result.

risk.basis_zh: 项目使用约 +22V、±15V、-20V 等电源轨，作者记录首块屏可能因 v1 板 FPC 焊接问题被烧坏。
risk.basis_en: The design uses rails around +22 V, ±15 V, and -20 V, and the author records that the first panel was likely fried by the v1 board's FPC soldering problem.

feasibility.basis_zh: 作者制作的两版 PCB 都有设计错误且无法修成可用，项目转向另一块转接板，没有可复刻的工作硬件。
feasibility.basis_en: Both PCB revisions had design errors and could not be repaired into working hardware; the author moved to another adapter and left no reproducible build.

docs_community.basis_zh: 项目页保留 5 篇日志、原理图、元件与明确失败原因，但没有安装说明、工作代码或 2017 年后的进展。
docs_community.basis_en: The page preserves five logs, a schematic, components, and explicit failure causes, but has no install instructions, working code, or progress after 2017.

practical_value.basis_zh: 树莓派太阳能电子墨水终端只是目标；两版板卡均失败，未实现屏幕、外壳、键盘或续航闭环。
practical_value.basis_en: The Raspberry Pi solar e-ink terminal remained a goal; both boards failed and no display, enclosure, keyboard, or battery-life loop was completed.

risk.basis_zh: 现有 PCB 已知不可用，且作者无法通过飞线修复；直接下单或接屏会重复已记录的硬件失败。
risk.basis_en: The available PCB revisions are known unusable and could not be bodge-repaired; ordering or connecting them would repeat a documented hardware failure.

feasibility.basis_zh: 项目仍在备料与研究阶段，未完成接线、代码或文件刷新实验；SD 卡逐页读取和是否需要越狱仍是作者待验证假设。
feasibility.basis_en: The project remains in parts-gathering and research, with no wiring, code, or file-refresh experiment; page-by-page SD reads and jailbreak requirements remain untested assumptions.

docs_community.basis_zh: 作者页清楚记录 PRS-700、SD 卡思路、电池电压与关键未知，但只有一篇日志、无文件、无说明和无工作演示。
docs_community.basis_en: The author clearly records the PRS-700 target, SD-card idea, battery voltages, and open questions, but there is only one log with no files, instructions, or working demonstration.

practical_value.basis_zh: 目前只是通过 SD 卡向旧阅读器注入动态文本的构想，尚无可用显示结果或稳定性证据。
practical_value.basis_en: It is currently only a concept for injecting changing text through an SD card, with no usable display result or stability evidence.

risk.basis_zh: 计划涉及把 3.7V 电池与需要 5V 的 Pico 共用供电、换更大电池和可能越狱；作者尚未给出充电、保护或接线验证。
risk.basis_en: The plan involves sharing a 3.7 V battery with a 5 V Pico, replacing the battery, and possibly jailbreaking, without validated charging, protection, or wiring guidance.

feasibility.basis_zh: OpenWrt 有精确设备页和安装/恢复资料，但同名设备存在 100M、千兆、地区版与不可刷 v3，方法还随原厂固件和闪存芯片变化。
feasibility.basis_en: OpenWrt has an exact device page and install/recovery material, but similarly named 100M, Gigabit, regional, and unsupported v3 variants exist, with procedures changing by stock firmware and flash chip.

docs_community.basis_zh: 官方设备页覆盖版本识别、硬件、安装、串口、已知问题、恢复和当前固件链接，并持续记录新硬件修订。
docs_community.basis_en: The official device page covers variant identification, hardware, installation, serial access, known issues, recovery, and current firmware links, with continuing hardware-revision notes.

practical_value.basis_zh: 受支持的 v1 千兆版可运行当前 OpenWrt，获得可维护的路由、双频 Wi-Fi、VLAN 与软件包能力；16 MB 闪存限制扩展空间。
practical_value.basis_en: Supported v1 Gigabit units can run current OpenWrt for maintainable routing, dual-band Wi-Fi, VLANs, and packages, though 16 MB flash limits expansion.

risk.basis_zh: 官方页连续警告 100M、R3Gv2、v3 等外观相似机型会因错镜像刷坏，并记录不同闪存与救砖条件。
risk.basis_en: The official page repeatedly warns that look-alike 100M, R3Gv2, and v3 hardware can be bricked by the wrong image and documents flash-chip-specific recovery constraints.

feasibility.basis_zh: RD03/RD23 有官方镜像与两条安装路径，但 API RCE 路线依赖原厂固件，UART 路线需拆机；RD03v2 是不同芯片且不受官方支持。
feasibility.basis_en: RD03/RD23 have official images and two install routes, but the API-RCE route depends on stock firmware and UART requires opening the device; RD03v2 is different hardware and unsupported.

docs_community.basis_zh: 官方设备页、硬件数据库、论坛主题、当前安装/升级镜像与版本警告齐全，支持从 23.05.4 延续到当前发布。
docs_community.basis_en: The official device page, hardware database, forum topic, current install/upgrade images, and variant warnings are available, with support from 23.05.4 through the current release.

practical_value.basis_zh: 受支持型号具双核 MT7981、256 MB RAM、128 MB NAND、四个千兆口和双频 Wi-Fi 6，可承担现代家庭主路由或实验节点。
practical_value.basis_en: Supported models provide dual-core MT7981, 256 MB RAM, 128 MB NAND, four Gigabit ports, and dual-band Wi-Fi 6, suitable for a modern home router or lab node.

risk.basis_zh: 官方明确警告先识别硬件并使用 25.12，错误版本可能刷坏；RCE、UART、分区写入和 RD03v2 混淆均提高风险。
risk.basis_en: Official documentation explicitly warns users to identify hardware and use 25.12 because other images may brick it; RCE, UART, partition writes, and RD03v2 confusion increase risk.

feasibility.basis_zh: 官方页给出 AX3200/RB01 与 AX6S/RB03 的共同硬件和安装流程，但初始解锁依赖原厂版本，部分新生产批次还需特殊 bootloader 处理。
feasibility.basis_en: The official page documents shared AX3200/RB01 and AX6S/RB03 hardware and installation, but initial access depends on stock firmware and some newer batches need special bootloader handling.

docs_community.basis_zh: 官方设备页、硬件表、长期开源论坛主题、当前版本与升级注意事项完整，并持续追踪新 bootloader 问题。
docs_community.basis_en: The official device page, hardware table, long-running forum topic, current release data, and upgrade notes are comprehensive and track the newer-bootloader issue.

practical_value.basis_zh: MT7622B 双核、256 MB RAM、128 MB NAND、四个千兆口和双频 Wi-Fi 6 对现代 OpenWrt 路由/网状网络仍有充分余量。
practical_value.basis_en: The dual-core MT7622B, 256 MB RAM, 128 MB NAND, four Gigabit ports, and dual-band Wi-Fi 6 leave useful headroom for modern OpenWrt routing and mesh roles.

risk.basis_zh: 官方页警告新 bootloader 可能在六次重启后软变砖，并指出 2023-12 后部分设备刷 sysupgrade 会变砖，必须先按批次核对规避方案。
risk.basis_en: The official page warns that newer bootloaders may soft-brick after six reboots and that some post-2023-12 units brick after sysupgrade, requiring batch-specific mitigation first.

feasibility.basis_zh: 上游提供 Python、配置文件和 Docker 路径，不需破解或刷写音箱；仍需核对硬件代号、小米登录及型号差异。
feasibility.basis_en: Upstream provides Python, configuration-file, and Docker routes without cracking or flashing the speaker; exact hardware IDs, Xiaomi login, and model-specific differences still need attention.

docs_community.basis_zh: README 覆盖安装、型号参数、Docker、模型与 TTS 后端和排障，主分支也有可核对的持续提交。
docs_community.basis_en: The README covers installation, model IDs, Docker, model/TTS backends, and troubleshooting, and the main branch has a checkable ongoing commit history.

practical_value.basis_zh: 可保留小爱音箱作为语音入口，接入多种大模型与 TTS，并支持连续对话和 Docker 常驻。
practical_value.basis_en: It keeps a XiaoAI speaker as the voice endpoint, connects multiple LLM and TTS providers, and supports continuous conversation and persistent Docker deployment.

risk.basis_zh: 不改写音箱固件，停止桥接服务即可退出；但配置会处理小米凭据、token 和模型 API 密钥。
risk.basis_en: It does not rewrite speaker firmware and can be stopped by ending the bridge service, but configuration handles Xiaomi credentials/tokens and model API keys.

feasibility.basis_zh: 仅支持 LX06/OH2P，需刷入 system0、启用 SSH 并部署客户端与服务端；旧版 LX06 还需拆机接调试口。
feasibility.basis_en: Only LX06/OH2P are supported; the route flashes system0, enables SSH, and deploys client/server components, while older LX06 units require disassembly for the debug port.

docs_community.basis_zh: 型号边界、刷机与服务端步骤较完整，但作者已明确停止维护和支持。
docs_community.basis_en: Model scope, flashing, and server procedures are detailed, but the author explicitly states that maintenance and support have ended.

practical_value.basis_zh: 补丁路线复用原麦克风、扬声器和小爱功能，同时增加可自托管的语音处理链路。
practical_value.basis_en: The patch route reuses the original microphone, speaker, and XiaoAI functions while adding a self-hostable voice-processing path.

risk.basis_zh: 官方教程明确警告刷机、失保和变砖，并默认开启 root SSH；boot1 仅在原分区完整时提供回退。
risk.basis_en: The upstream guide explicitly warns about flashing, warranty loss, and bricking and enables root SSH by default; boot1 is a fallback only while the original partition remains intact.

feasibility.basis_zh: 提供 Docker 与 Node.js 两条服务端路径和参数模板，不需拆机或替换音箱固件；仍需配置小米账号和设备属性。
feasibility.basis_en: Docker and Node.js server paths plus parameter templates are provided without disassembly or firmware replacement; Xiaomi credentials and device properties still need configuration.

docs_community.basis_zh: README、设置文档和兼容表内容充足，但项目已明确停止维护和支持。
docs_community.basis_en: The README, settings guide, and compatibility table are substantial, but the project explicitly ended maintenance and support.

practical_value.basis_zh: 兼容表覆盖多款小爱音箱和家庭屏，服务可把现有语音入口桥接到多种对话模型。
practical_value.basis_en: The compatibility table covers many XiaoAI speakers/displays, and the service bridges the existing voice endpoint to multiple conversational models.

risk.basis_zh: 桥接路线不刷音箱，变砖风险较低；但配置承载小米账号或 token、模型密钥并依赖厂商云接口。
risk.basis_en: The bridge does not flash the speaker, so bricking risk is low; configuration carries Xiaomi account/token and model secrets and depends on vendor cloud interfaces.

feasibility.basis_zh: 需拆开二代 Nest Mini、订制并替换 ESP32-S3 PCBA、刷写固件，再配置常开语音服务端。
feasibility.basis_en: It requires opening a second-generation Nest Mini, ordering and replacing an ESP32-S3 PCBA, flashing firmware, and configuring an always-on voice server.

docs_community.basis_zh: 仓库公开 PCB、固件、服务端代码和示例，但作者已标为弃用并指向 v2。
docs_community.basis_en: PCB files, firmware, server code, and examples are published, but the author marks the project deprecated and points users to v2.

practical_value.basis_zh: 能复用外壳、麦克风和扬声器，但上游明确定位为实验性对话平台，而非完整家庭助理或音乐播放器。
practical_value.basis_en: It reuses the enclosure, microphone, and speaker, but upstream calls it an experimental conversational platform rather than a full home assistant or music-player replacement.

risk.basis_zh: 路线需拆机、替换整块主板并刷自制板固件，还会保存家庭自动化或模型服务凭据。
risk.basis_en: The route opens the device, replaces its mainboard, flashes custom-board firmware, and stores home-automation or model-service credentials.

feasibility.basis_zh: 仍需自制 Nest Mini 替换板或另购 ATOM Echo，安装音频依赖、配置服务端并刷 ESP32。
feasibility.basis_en: It still needs either a custom Nest Mini replacement board or an ATOM Echo, audio dependencies, server configuration, and ESP32 flashing.

docs_community.basis_zh: README 详述协议、硬件选项、服务管线、安装、刷写与 PCB 文件，且作为前代的当前继任版本仍有提交。
docs_community.basis_en: The README details protocols, hardware choices, server pipeline, installation, flashing, and PCB files, and the current successor still has commits.

practical_value.basis_zh: 支持多终端、Opus、本地或 OpenAI 兼容模型、VAD 与流式 TTS，并有自制板和现成开发板两条路线。
practical_value.basis_en: It supports multiple endpoints, Opus, local or OpenAI-compatible models, VAD, streaming TTS, and both custom-board and off-the-shelf routes.

risk.basis_zh: 自制板路线需拆机和刷写，代理模式还保存网关 token；保留原主板可回退，但组装损伤与凭据风险仍在。
risk.basis_en: The custom-board route requires disassembly and flashing, while agent mode stores a gateway token; retaining the original board helps rollback, but hardware and credential risks remain.

feasibility.basis_zh: 有安装脚本和 Pi Zero 2 W 教程，但仍需配置 Linux、ALSA、Home Assistant/Wyoming 与可选唤醒词服务。
feasibility.basis_en: An install script and Pi Zero 2 W tutorial are available, but Linux, ALSA, Home Assistant/Wyoming, and optional wake-word services still need configuration.

docs_community.basis_zh: 安装、音频、VAD 和唤醒词资料完整，但仓库已明确停止维护并由 Linux Voice Assistant 取代。
docs_community.basis_en: Installation, audio, VAD, and wake-word documentation is substantial, but the repository is explicitly unmaintained and replaced by Linux Voice Assistant.

practical_value.basis_zh: 可把闲置 Linux/Pi 设备变成 Home Assistant 远端语音卫星，但新功能已转移到继任项目。
practical_value.basis_en: It can turn spare Linux/Pi hardware into a Home Assistant remote voice satellite, but new functionality has moved to its successor.

risk.basis_zh: 以用户态服务运行，不替换固件或引导程序，可通过停用服务回退；主要边界是局域网音频与 HA 配置。
risk.basis_en: It runs as a user-space service without replacing firmware or boot code and can be rolled back by removing the service; its main boundary is LAN audio and HA configuration.

feasibility.basis_zh: 提供 HA 应用、Docker 和 systemd 路线，但主机仍需 x64/ARM64 Linux、可用音频设备及对应音频栈。
feasibility.basis_en: Home Assistant app, Docker, and systemd routes are available, but the host still needs x64/ARM64 Linux, working audio hardware, and the required audio stack.

docs_community.basis_zh: 当前仓库提供容器、发布版、安装路线、硬件建议和制品证明，且持续提交；上游仍称其为实验性。
docs_community.basis_en: The current repository provides containers, releases, install paths, hardware guidance, and artifact attestations with ongoing commits; upstream still calls it experimental.

practical_value.basis_zh: 可让通用旧 Linux 硬件承担 HA Assist 语音终端、唤醒词、播报、连续对话和计时器。
practical_value.basis_en: It turns general spare Linux hardware into a Home Assistant Assist endpoint with wake words, announcements, continued conversation, and timers.

risk.basis_zh: 主要以容器或系统服务运行，不写设备固件；但它仍会采集麦克风音频并接入局域网 HA。
risk.basis_en: It runs mainly as a container or system service and does not write device firmware, though it captures microphone audio and connects to Home Assistant on the LAN.

feasibility.basis_zh: 上游为常见平台提供自动安装、容器和首次配置向导，路由器端只需把网络 DNS 指向服务。
feasibility.basis_en: Upstream provides automated installation, containers, and a first-run wizard for common platforms; router-side work is mainly directing network DNS to the service.

docs_community.basis_zh: 官方知识库覆盖安装、网络配置、客户端与安全设置，主仓库持续提交并链接 API 与集成资料。
docs_community.basis_en: The official knowledge base covers installation, network setup, clients, and security settings, while the main repository remains active and links API/integration material.

practical_value.basis_zh: 可为全网设备统一过滤广告与跟踪，并内置 DHCP、自定义规则、加密上游 DNS 与 DoH/DoT 服务。
practical_value.basis_en: It provides network-wide ad/tracker filtering plus DHCP, custom rules, encrypted upstream DNS, and DoH/DoT service capabilities.

risk.basis_zh: 无需改写路由器固件，但作为全网 DNS 或 DHCP 中心，配置错误会影响整网解析或地址分配；上游提供 HTTPS、访问控制和加密 DNS。
risk.basis_en: It need not rewrite router firmware, but a mistake in a network-wide DNS/DHCP role can disrupt resolution or addressing; upstream provides HTTPS, access controls, and encrypted DNS.

feasibility.basis_zh: 官方 wiki 说明可像普通华硕固件一样通过 Web UI 刷入，但必须先核对当前支持型号及少数降级前置条件。
feasibility.basis_en: The official wiki says it can be flashed through the web UI like regular Asus firmware, but the current supported-model list and occasional downgrade prerequisites must be checked first.

docs_community.basis_zh: 仓库、持续提交、百余页 wiki 与 SNBForums 支持覆盖安装、功能和排障；支持清单有明确更新时间。
docs_community.basis_en: The repository, active commit history, extensive wiki, and SNBForums support cover installation, features, and troubleshooting, and the support matrix is explicitly maintained.

practical_value.basis_zh: 在受支持的现代华硕路由器上保留原 Asuswrt 使用方式，同时提供增强功能、修复与性能改进。
practical_value.basis_en: On supported modern Asus routers it preserves the Asuswrt operating model while adding enhancements, fixes, and performance improvements.

risk.basis_zh: 仍属固件刷写，但上游称现代机型很难刷砖并说明备用固件或恢复模式；跨版本配置恢复仍不保证可靠。
risk.basis_en: It is still a firmware flash, but upstream says modern units are hard to brick and documents backup-firmware or recovery mode; restoring settings across versions is not guaranteed.

feasibility.basis_zh: 上游提供一行安装脚本、Web 界面和 Docker 应用管理，适合在现有 Debian/Ubuntu 类旧主机上部署。
feasibility.basis_en: Upstream provides a one-line installer, web UI, and Docker app management suitable for an existing Debian/Ubuntu-class spare host.

docs_community.basis_zh: README 链接用户文档、论坛、Discord 与开发资料，主分支保持可核对的提交活动。
docs_community.basis_en: The README links user docs, forum, Discord, and development material, and the main branch has checkable commit activity.

practical_value.basis_zh: 把闲置主机变成可视化家庭云，集中管理文件、存储与 Docker 应用。
practical_value.basis_en: It turns a spare host into a visual home-cloud system for centralized files, storage, and Docker applications.

feasibility.basis_zh: Cockpit 在多种 Linux 发行版中直接提供软件包，安装后通过浏览器登录真实系统会话，无需替换系统。
feasibility.basis_en: Cockpit is packaged by many Linux distributions and exposes a real system session in the browser after installation without replacing the OS.

docs_community.basis_zh: 官方运行指南与管理员文档覆盖发行版、认证、HTTPS 和多主机管理，主仓库持续活跃。
docs_community.basis_en: Official running and administration guides cover distributions, authentication, HTTPS, and multi-host management, and the main repository remains active.

practical_value.basis_zh: 可从浏览器管理旧 Linux 主机的容器、存储、网络、服务与日志，并通过 SSH 跳转到其他主机。
practical_value.basis_en: It manages containers, storage, networking, services, and logs on an old Linux host and can jump to other machines over SSH.

risk.basis_zh: Web 会话具有真实系统管理权限，端口暴露或账户配置错误影响较大；官方默认要求 HTTPS，并用系统 PAM 或 SSH 认证。
risk.basis_en: The web session carries real system-administration authority, so exposure or account mistakes have high impact; official defaults require HTTPS and use system PAM or SSH authentication.

feasibility.basis_zh: 官方提供独立服务自动安装和 Docker 路线、首次设置向导与卸载方式；完整存储功能仍需若干系统依赖。
feasibility.basis_en: Official docs provide standalone-service and Docker routes, a first-setup wizard, and uninstall steps; full storage features still require several system dependencies.

docs_community.basis_zh: 官方文档覆盖安装、应用、代理、认证、备份和存储，仓库持续提交并提供讨论区。
docs_community.basis_en: Official docs cover installation, apps, proxying, authentication, backups, and storage, while the repository has ongoing commits and discussions.

practical_value.basis_zh: 集成应用商店、磁盘与网络存储、反向代理、自动 HTTPS、认证和多因素验证，覆盖家庭服务器的核心操作。
practical_value.basis_en: It combines an app store, disk and network storage, reverse proxy, automatic HTTPS, authentication, and MFA for core home-server operations.

risk.basis_zh: 管理容器需访问 Docker socket，自动安装还会以 root 安装依赖；一旦管理面被攻破，影响范围可覆盖整台主机和应用。
risk.basis_en: Container management needs Docker-socket access and the automatic installer runs as root to add dependencies, so compromise of the management plane can affect the whole host and its apps.

feasibility.basis_zh: x86_64 有启动安装 ISO，ARM 有磁盘镜像；首启向导和 Web UI 管理磁盘、存储池、共享与插件。
feasibility.basis_en: x86_64 has a bootable installer ISO and ARM has disk images; a first-boot wizard and web UI manage disks, pools, shares, and add-ons.

docs_community.basis_zh: README 与项目站点覆盖架构、安装、恢复和插件，主分支保持近期提交；社区规模不足以按满分处理。
docs_community.basis_en: The README and project site cover architecture, installation, recovery, and add-ons, with recent main-branch commits; community scale is not treated as top-tier.

practical_value.basis_zh: 提供 Btrfs 存储池、RAID、压缩、快照、自描述池与 Samba/NFS 等完整 NAS 功能。
practical_value.basis_en: It provides Btrfs pools, RAID, compression, snapshots, self-describing pools, Samba/NFS, and other full NAS functions.

risk.basis_zh: 安装器会写系统盘，数据盘流程包含擦除和准备；自描述池利于重装后发现，但不能替代备份和目标盘确认。
risk.basis_en: The installer writes a system disk and data-disk workflows include wiping/preparation; self-describing pools aid rediscovery but do not replace backups and target-disk checks.

feasibility.basis_zh: 它是生成预配置 OpenWrt 镜像的框架，部署前需建立站点配置、选择精确硬件目标并构建固件，不是通用即装镜像。
feasibility.basis_en: It is a framework for building preconfigured OpenWrt images, so deployment requires a site configuration, exact hardware targets, and a firmware build rather than a universal ready-to-flash image.

docs_community.basis_zh: 官方手册系统覆盖站点、构建、特性、升级和开发，主仓库持续提交并有明确发布流程。
docs_community.basis_en: The official manual systematically covers sites, builds, features, upgrades, and development, while the main repository has ongoing commits and an explicit release process.

practical_value.basis_zh: 可把兼容路由器组成免客户端的去中心化有线或无线网状网络，并通过 VPN 网关连接互联网或其他网状云。
practical_value.basis_en: It can turn compatible routers into a clientless decentralized wired/wireless mesh and connect mesh clouds or the Internet through VPN gateways.

risk.basis_zh: 需按目标刷写路由器并维护站点升级链；签名自动更新可降低供应链风险，但错误镜像或配置仍可使节点离线。
risk.basis_en: It requires target-specific router flashing and a maintained site upgrade path; signed automatic updates mitigate supply-chain risk, but a wrong image or configuration can still take nodes offline.

feasibility.basis_zh: 网络社区需创建自己的固件配置并用 Buildroot 或 ImageBuilder 构建精确目标镜像；上游要求仔细遵循型号刷机说明。
feasibility.basis_en: A community must create its own firmware profile and build exact target images with Buildroot or ImageBuilder; upstream requires careful model-specific flashing instructions.

docs_community.basis_zh: README、项目站点、构建文档和 OpenWrt 型号资料形成可用链路，仓库仍有提交；资料比成熟发行版更偏构建者。
docs_community.basis_en: The README, project site, build docs, and OpenWrt model material form a usable path and the repository remains active, though documentation is more builder-oriented than a mature distribution.

practical_value.basis_zh: 可部署自动配置、多无线电的自由网状网络，适合复用兼容 OpenWrt 路由器搭建社区网络。
practical_value.basis_en: It deploys auto-configurable multi-radio free mesh networks and can reuse compatible OpenWrt routers for community networking.

risk.basis_zh: 上游明确表示硬件清单不作保证，并要求格外谨慎刷机；选错 target/profile 会直接威胁路由器可启动性。
risk.basis_en: Upstream explicitly gives no warranty for the hardware list and urges extra care when flashing; a wrong target/profile directly threatens router bootability.

feasibility.basis_zh: 可在现有 Linux 文件系统之上安装并用一条挂载配置合并路径；快速入门也给出常见内核版本的推荐设置。
feasibility.basis_en: It installs over existing Linux filesystems and merges paths with a mount configuration; the quick start gives recommended settings for common kernel versions.

docs_community.basis_zh: 官方文档覆盖安装、策略、错误处理、兼容、迁移与性能，仓库保持持续提交和明确支持渠道。
docs_community.basis_en: Official docs cover installation, policies, error handling, compatibility, migration, and performance, with ongoing commits and an explicit support route.

practical_value.basis_zh: 可把不同大小和类型的普通磁盘路径合并成单一挂载点，并在不影响其他数据时增删分支。
practical_value.basis_en: It combines commodity disks of different sizes/types into one mount point and can add or remove branches without affecting the rest of the data.

risk.basis_zh: 它代理底层路径而不接管块设备，单盘失败不影响其他盘数据；但不提供冗余，删除与放置行为仍取决于策略。
risk.basis_en: It proxies underlying paths rather than owning block devices, and one filesystem failure does not affect other data; it provides no redundancy, and delete/placement behavior still depends on policy.

feasibility.basis_zh: 可在干净的受支持 Linux 上安装并用 Web 管理，但要求 x86-64、静态 IP、SSD、外网与正确 DNS，且不支持 LXC。
feasibility.basis_en: It installs on a clean supported Linux system with web administration, but requires x86-64, static IP, SSD, Internet, correct DNS, and does not support LXC.

docs_community.basis_zh: 管理员、开发者与 API 文档覆盖安装、应用、集群、备份和恢复，主仓库与社区论坛保持活动。
docs_community.basis_en: Administrator, developer, and API docs cover installation, apps, clustering, backup, and recovery, while the main repository and community remain active.

practical_value.basis_zh: 单机可运行多种容器化服务器应用，之后还能扩为多节点集群，并内置应用级备份、保留策略和恢复。
practical_value.basis_en: A single node can run multiple containerized server apps, later expand into a cluster, and use built-in app backups, retention policies, and restores.

risk.basis_zh: 官方要求干净专用主机并提示端口、DNS 和外联约束；加密集群备份与灾难恢复降低回退风险，但配置错误可影响整组应用。
risk.basis_en: Official guidance requires a clean dedicated host and documents port, DNS, and outbound constraints; encrypted cluster backups and disaster recovery reduce rollback risk, but mistakes can affect all hosted apps.

feasibility.basis_zh: 完整落地需部署控制器、数据库/服务组件，并在每台 OpenWrt 设备安装和注册代理，复杂度高于单路由器固件。
feasibility.basis_en: A full deployment needs the controller and its service stack plus an installed and registered agent on every OpenWrt device, making it more complex than a single-router firmware.

docs_community.basis_zh: 官方稳定版文档覆盖安装器、控制器、代理、监控、拓扑、固件升级和 API，仓库持续提交并有支持渠道。
docs_community.basis_en: Stable official docs cover installers, controller, agents, monitoring, topology, firmware upgrades, and APIs, with ongoing repository activity and support channels.

practical_value.basis_zh: 可集中自动化设备接入、配置下发、管理 VPN、证书、IP 分配和批量固件更新，适合多路由器复用。
practical_value.basis_en: It centralizes device adoption, configuration, management VPNs, certificates, IP allocation, and mass firmware upgrades, making it valuable for fleets of reused routers.

risk.basis_zh: 中央控制器被误配或攻破会波及多台设备；代理默认校验 TLS，并提供共享密钥和配置测试作为防护。
risk.basis_en: A misconfigured or compromised controller can affect many devices; the agent verifies TLS by default and provides shared-secret registration and configuration testing safeguards.

feasibility.basis_zh: 常见发行版可从标准包安装工具，但可靠建池前必须理解 Copy-on-Write、VDEV 与池布局。
feasibility.basis_en: Utilities install from standard packages on common distributions, but reliable pool construction requires understanding copy-on-write, VDEVs, and pool layout.

docs_community.basis_zh: 官方文档维护多发行版安装和 root-on-ZFS 指南，仓库列明支持平台并持续开发。
docs_community.basis_en: Official docs maintain multi-distribution installation and root-on-ZFS guides, while the repository lists supported platforms and remains active.

practical_value.basis_zh: 为旧 NAS 或小主机提供池化存储、校验、快照和 Copy-on-Write 等核心数据能力，覆盖 Linux 与 FreeBSD。
practical_value.basis_en: It gives old NAS or mini-PC hosts pooled storage, checksumming, snapshots, and copy-on-write across Linux and FreeBSD.

risk.basis_zh: 官方入门页指出池布局是最难撤销的决定；选错 VDEV 或目标盘会形成高代价、难回退的存储结构。
risk.basis_en: Official getting-started guidance says pool layout is the hardest decision to undo; a wrong VDEV or target disk creates a costly, difficult-to-reverse storage structure.

feasibility.basis_zh: 官方镜像和安装器支持通用 x86-64 小主机，但需准备独立存储、控制台、兼容网卡并完成 WAN/LAN 初始配置。
feasibility.basis_en: Official images and installer support generic x86-64 mini PCs, but deployment needs dedicated storage, console access, compatible NICs, and initial WAN/LAN configuration.

docs_community.basis_zh: 官方手册覆盖硬件、安装、配置备份和恢复，核心仓库持续提交并公开构建体系。
docs_community.basis_en: The official manual covers hardware, installation, configuration backup, and restore, while the core repository has ongoing commits and an open build system.

practical_value.basis_zh: 可把旧 x86-64 小主机变成完整开源防火墙和路由平台，覆盖常规网关、安全和插件用途。
practical_value.basis_en: It turns an old x86-64 mini PC into a full open-source firewall/router platform for gateway, security, and plugin use cases.

risk.basis_zh: 安装会写目标盘，接口或防火墙配置错误可能导致断网；官方支持完整配置备份、历史比较、恢复和接口重映射。
risk.basis_en: Installation writes the target disk and interface/firewall mistakes can cut connectivity; official tooling supports full configuration backups, history comparison, restore, and interface reassignment.

feasibility.basis_zh: Netgate 安装器和完整步骤支持通用 AMD64 硬件，Web UI 降低日常门槛，但仍需写盘、控制台和接口分配。
feasibility.basis_en: The Netgate installer and full procedure support generic AMD64 hardware, and the web UI lowers daily administration effort, but installation still needs disk writing, console access, and interface assignment.

docs_community.basis_zh: 官方文档系统覆盖安装、升级、备份、恢复和故障处理，核心仓库保持持续提交。
docs_community.basis_en: Official documentation systematically covers installation, upgrades, backup, restore, and troubleshooting, and the core repository remains active.

practical_value.basis_zh: 可把旧小主机转成具备 Web 管理和扩展包的完整 FreeBSD 防火墙/路由系统。
practical_value.basis_en: It turns an old mini PC into a full FreeBSD firewall/router with web administration and add-on packages.

risk.basis_zh: 作为网络核心，错误规则、接口或恢复操作可能造成断网；官方提供加密配置备份、多种恢复路径及安装时恢复。
risk.basis_en: As the network core, bad rules, interfaces, or restore choices can cause outages; official docs provide encrypted configuration backups and several restore paths, including during install.

feasibility.basis_zh: 跨 Linux、macOS、Windows 与 BSD 提供单一命令行工作流，快速指南从建库、备份、查看到恢复均有可复制步骤。
feasibility.basis_en: A single command-line workflow spans Linux, macOS, Windows, and BSD, with copyable quick-start steps from repository creation through backup, listing, and restore.

docs_community.basis_zh: 官方手册详述存储后端、自动化、检查、恢复与保留策略，仓库和官方论坛均保持活动。
docs_community.basis_en: The official manual details storage backends, automation, checks, restore, and retention, while both the repository and official forum remain active.

practical_value.basis_zh: 为旧 NAS/小主机提供加密、去重、快照式备份和多种本地/远端后端，并支持校验与恢复。
practical_value.basis_en: It gives an old NAS/mini PC encrypted, deduplicated snapshot backups across many local/remote backends, with verification and restore workflows.

risk.basis_zh: 备份本身不改写固件，但密码丢失会使数据不可恢复，同机仓库也不构成真实备份；必须验证恢复并妥善保管密钥。
risk.basis_en: It does not rewrite firmware, but losing the password makes data irrecoverable and a same-machine repository is not a real backup; restore testing and key custody are essential.

feasibility.basis_zh: 作为完整 Linux/Btrfs NAS 发行版可装到通用硬件，但上游明确预期用户具备 PC、Pi4 或 ARM64 系统安装经验。
feasibility.basis_en: It is a complete Linux/Btrfs NAS distribution for commodity hardware, but upstream explicitly expects PC, Pi4, or ARM64 OS-installation experience.

docs_community.basis_zh: 官方仓库、文档和论坛覆盖安装、存储、Rock-ons 与 API，开发者在论坛参与且仓库仍有提交。
docs_community.basis_en: The official repository, docs, and forum cover installation, storage, Rock-ons, and APIs, with developer participation and ongoing commits.

practical_value.basis_zh: 在通用旧硬件上提供 Btrfs NAS、Web 管理、Docker Rock-ons 和 REST API，兼顾存储与家庭服务器扩展。
practical_value.basis_en: It provides Btrfs NAS storage, web management, Docker-based Rock-ons, and a REST API on commodity spare hardware.

feasibility.basis_zh: 基于 Docker，提供安装文档、简单 Web UI 与应用商店，减少手工网络和服务配置；仍需维护 Linux 主机。
feasibility.basis_en: It is Docker-based with installation docs, a simple web UI, and an app store that reduces manual network/service work; the Linux host still needs maintenance.

docs_community.basis_zh: 仓库、文档、应用商店和社区渠道覆盖安装与扩展，develop 分支持续提交；上游仍称系统处于积极开发。
docs_community.basis_en: The repository, docs, app store, and community channels cover installation and extension, with ongoing develop-branch commits; upstream still calls the system actively developed.

practical_value.basis_zh: 可在单台旧服务器集中安装和管理多种自托管服务，并支持官方与社区应用商店。
practical_value.basis_en: It centralizes many self-hosted services on one spare server and supports official and community app stores.

risk.basis_zh: 上游声明志愿维护不保证支持或安全，稳定版也可能有缺陷；集中运行多项联网服务会扩大旧主机攻击面。
risk.basis_en: Upstream states that volunteer maintenance provides no guarantee of support or security and stable releases may still have bugs; many networked services expand the host attack surface.

feasibility.basis_zh: 每台 Kirkwood NAS 都要精确核对 SoC、U-Boot、MTD、串口和 rootfs；DS211 路线要求串口、备份并建议先用 kwboot 测试。
feasibility.basis_en: Each Kirkwood NAS needs exact SoC, U-Boot, MTD, serial, and rootfs matching; the DS211 route requires serial, backups, and recommends kwboot testing first.

docs_community.basis_zh: 维护者长帖持续发布 Kirkwood 内核、rootfs、校验和与多机型说明，但材料主要仍是论坛长帖。
docs_community.basis_en: The maintainer thread continues publishing Kirkwood kernels, rootfs images, checksums, and multi-device notes, though the material remains forum-thread based.

practical_value.basis_zh: 可让许多厂商系统老化的 Kirkwood NAS 运行较新 Debian 内核/rootfs，并继续使用盘位、网络与 USB。
practical_value.basis_en: It lets many aging-vendor-OS Kirkwood NAS devices run newer Debian kernels/rootfs while retaining drive bays, networking, and USB.

risk.basis_zh: DS211 指南明确说新 U-Boot 会清除原厂固件，并警告错误 MTD 定义会变砖；须先备份闪存并准备串口/kwboot 救援。
risk.basis_en: The DS211 guide says the new U-Boot wipes stock firmware and warns that wrong MTD definitions cause bricks; full flash backups and serial/kwboot rescue are required.

feasibility.basis_zh: 原作者需匹配特定 Armbian 构建和 DTB；同名 T95Z Plus 存在 Wi-Fi、eMMC 乃至 NAND 变体，必须先识别硬件。
feasibility.basis_en: The author had to match a specific Armbian build and DTB; same-name T95Z Plus units vary in Wi-Fi, eMMC, and even NAND, so hardware identification is mandatory.

docs_community.basis_zh: 现有证据是一条具体用户构建帖及后续 ZFS 讨论，给出镜像、DTB 和状态，但不是完整统一的官方教程。
docs_community.basis_en: Evidence is one concrete user-build thread plus ZFS follow-up, with image, DTB, and working-state details, but not a complete model-unified official guide.

practical_value.basis_zh: 作者报告两台盒子可作稳定无头服务器，其中一台运行简单 ZFS NAS；但 Wi-Fi 失效、网速未测且硬件一致性差。
practical_value.basis_en: The author reports two boxes working as headless servers and one as a simple ZFS NAS, but Wi-Fi failed, network speed was unmeasured, and hardware consistency is poor.
